cases.answer: IIT Jodhpur offers a wide range of facilities, including: ### **Health Centre (HC)** - **24/7 Medical Officers** and **Nursing Officers** (male & female). - **Regular visits** by specialist doctors (Psychiatrist, Gynaecologist, Paediatrician, ENT, Medicine, Orthopaedician). - **Diagnostic Laboratory** for medical testing. - Round-the-clock healthcare services for students, faculty, staff, and their dependents. ### **Research & Development Facilities** 1. **Fab Facility (AIoT Fab)**: - State-of-the-art instruments for sensor development and IoT ecosystems. - Focus areas: photonics, biotechnology, solar cells, flexible sensors, and wearable devices. - Includes MEMS technology for inertial sensors. - Ongoing upgrades with new instruments. 2. **Metallography Laboratory**: - Equipment: Grinding/polishing machines, metallographic specimen cutoff machine, stereo-zoom microscopes, electronic weigh balance, density measurement system, specimen leveling press. 3. **Mechanical Testing Laboratory**: - Facilities: Universal Testing Machines, Charpy/Izod impact testers, microhardness tester, Superficial Rockwell hardness tester, Brinell hardness tester, Vickers hardness tester, pin-on-disc wear tester, polarimeter, and photo-elasticity unit. - Supports materials processing, testing, and computational materials engineering. ### **Other Facilities** - **State-of-the-art laboratories** for biotechnology, life sciences, and deep tech research. - Collaboration facilities for AIoT technologies with industry and academic partners. These facilities cater to academic, research, and healthcare needs across the institute.

cases.answer: To be eligible for the **M.Tech (Regular) program** at IIT Jodhpur, applicants must meet the following criteria: ### **Academic Qualifications** 1. **Bachelor’s Degree**: - A **bachelor’s degree in engineering or science** (4-year program) - OR a **master’s degree in science, MCA, Pharmacy, Medical Sciences, Agricultural Sciences, Veterinary Sciences**, or a related field. 2. **Minimum Academic Performance**: - **60% marks** (or equivalent CGPA) for **GEN/OBC** categories. - **55% marks** (or equivalent CGPA) for **SC/ST** categories. - **CGPA Requirements**: - **6.0** (or equivalent) for GEN/OBC (on a 10-scale). - **5.5** (or equivalent) for SC/ST (on a 10-scale). - For other scales (e.g., 8-scale), proportional requirements apply: - **4.8** for GEN/OBC (4.4 for SC/ST). ### **Entrance Exam Requirements** Applicants must satisfy **one of the following**: 1. **Valid GATE Score**: - A valid GATE score as per the MHRD guidelines. 2. **Exemption from GATE**: - Exempted under the MHRD circular. 3. **Equivalent National Examination**: - Qualified in an equivalent national-level exam. 4. **IIT Jodhpur’s Own Test/Interview**: - Qualified in a written test and/or interview conducted by IIT Jodhpur. These criteria are applicable for regular M.Tech admissions. For other modes (e.g., dual-degree programs), additional rules may apply.

cases.answer: The regular Ph.D. eligibility requirements at IIT Jodhpur include the following: 1. **Minimum Qualifications**: Candidates must meet the absolute minimum eligibility criteria prescribed by the institute. These criteria are based on academic qualifications and qualifying exams, though specific details (e.g., minimum marks, qualifying exams) are not explicitly outlined in the provided context. 2. **Relaxation for SC/ST/PD Candidates**: The qualifying degree marks are relaxed as per the rules of the Ministry of Education. 3. **Employment Status**: Candidates admitted in the regular Ph.D. mode must not be registered students in any other academic program (in India or abroad) or employed as full-time/part-time employees of any organization (in India or abroad). 4. **Admission Process**: CETE (Center for Excellence in Teaching and Education) may apply higher performance criteria than the minimum if the number of applications exceeds available seats.
